At frame 0, Person A wears a bulky white extravehicular suit and a transparent domed helmet and carries a large white rectangular backpack; an extended light-colored glove and one light-colored boot are visible. A face is discernible inside the visor, the visor has blue-gray reflections, and a white casing surrounds the helmet; the fabric of the sleeves and legs is densely wrinkled, there are red bands at the thighs, the chest and abdomen have a light-colored control box and dark ports, and the backpack has a gray grooved frame and an outward-projecting bracket.

At frame 0, the gold foil-covered equipment assembly has multiple gold box-shaped components, a broad curved housing, and dark brackets; the foil surface is densely covered with wrinkles and bright highlights. The long narrow component has a dark rectangular recess, the broad housing has a curved metal edge, and thin silver handrail rods, folded edges, dark connectors, and curved strip-like structures are visible between the components.

At frame 0, the black outer-space background appears as large, nearly uniform deep-black areas surrounding Person A and the gold foil-covered equipment assembly, and forms clear boundaries along the outlines of Person A's white clothing, backpack, and the equipment.
